title: Protection warrior: taunts a mob off the healer and off a DPS player within 5 s

rules.desc: A mob that hits the healer (extra1) or the DPS player gets a taunt from the Protection warrior (Taunt, Mocking Blow or Challenging Shout) on that mob within 5 s, at least 70 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 12 s, one counted answer per 10 s: Taunt's cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:126-128 (lose aggro -> taunt, ACTION_INTERRUPT + 1), :129-131 (mocking blow taunt -> mocking blow, ACTION_INTERRUPT), :136-138 (party member attacked -> taunt on attacker, ACTION_INTERRUPT + 1), :27 (taunt -> battle shout taunt), :63-65 (defensive stance row); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/WarriorActions.h:437-445 (CastTauntOnAttackerAction: target 'attacker of non-tank target'); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.h:112-121 (PartyMemberAttackedTrigger); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:312-349 (LoseAggroTrigger; the tank-player exception at :328-343); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:4026-4047 (IsTank: the forced role decides first, :4028-4030); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: two rows answer: 'lose aggro' when the tank's current target is on a non-tank, and 'party member attacked' -> taunt on attacker for any mob on a non-tank member (both INTERRUPT+1, above every DPS row). The player is forced to dps (PlayerbotAI.cpp:4028-4030) and the priest is a healer, so every mob on either of them qualifies. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: At most 30 percent of the mob damage events (hits counted, not amounts) land on the healer or the DPS player; the rest on the tank
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:126-138,148-150,164-166 (taunt rows, shield block, thunder clap); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:312-349 (LoseAggroTrigger; the tank-player exception at :328-343); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: an outcome, not a single row: the player opens every mob (the runner pulls with the player), so each mob lands a few hits on him before the taunt, and the priest's heal threat can pull a fresh mob. No baseline yet; the first before-run sets the number

rules.desc: The Protection warrior holds Defensive Stance (aura 71) for at least 85 percent of its in-combat samples
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:63-65 (defensive stance row, ACTION_HIGH + 2), :230-234 (overpower dance leaves it briefly), :129-131 (Mocking Blow needs Battle Stance); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/WarriorTriggers.h:20 (DefensiveStanceTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the standalone stance row returns the bot to Defensive Stance on the next tick; only the overpower dance and a Mocking Blow leave it, for one swap and back

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
